en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a statue of Crown Prince Rudolf standing on a large stone pedestal in a park. Rudolf is dressed in hunting attire, holding a rifle, with trees in the background. The top of the postcard bears red printed text in Hungarian and German identifying the monument in Budapest; a small red number is printed vertically along the right edge. The pedestal is inscribed with the name 'RUDOLF' and there is a wreath or floral arrangement at its base.
